updates.title: NO.BOYS.ALLOWED™ is casting
updates.body: Issue 002 is open for applications. All-girls cast, overnight shoot, VHS treatment. Apply through the casting board — invite-only spots are filled from applicants first.

updates.title: SWIM 001 sets are live in the Vault
updates.body: Every approved frame from SWIM is now in the Vault and counted toward your content units. Check your ledger below for your count.

updates.title: Royalty system v1.0 in effect
updates.body: 60 house / 40 model pool, quarterly, one photo or one video is one content unit. Applies to Vault-approved content from SWIM 001 forward. Changes are always prospective — nothing is ever recalculated backward.
